name: Stunt Show Truck & Bike
instructions: omr/instructions/42106-1-1.pdf (one book, 120 pages: bag 1 the bike, bag 2 the trailer, bags 3-4 the truck and the fire ring, steps 1-130 on pages 5-115; page 116 shows the functions)

functions.does: The black 12 tooth gear on the truck's cab roof steers the front wheels: its upright shaft drives a bevel gear on a long shaft running forward under the bonnet, whose 12 tooth gear slides the steering rack joining the two steering knuckles.
functions.source: book: steps 26-27 (the gears and shafts), step 35 (yellow arrows: turn the shaft, the knuckles turn), step 47 (arrows on the front wheels), steps 62-63 (the shaft up through the cab and the gear on top), page 116 (arrow on the roof gear and a front wheel)

functions.does: The truck's four wheels roll freely; there's no drive. The two rear wheels turn together on one axle; each front wheel turns on its own short axle in its steering knuckle.
The trailer hitches on a pin at the truck's back and swings behind it as the truck turns.
functions.note: inferred: the book shows it hitched but draws no arrow for the swing

functions.does: The 12 tooth gear on the trailer's side swings the blue legs at its front down, so the unhitched trailer stands as a launch ramp sloping down to its back end.
functions.source: book: page 116 middle inset (arrows on the gear and the legs); the trailer is bag 2
functions.note: inferred: which of the trailer's parts are the legs, from their place under its front (body of p2084, p2089, p2095); the book doesn't show how the gear drives them

functions.does: The trailer's two wheels roll freely together on one axle line.
The bike's rear wheel winds its pull-back motor: a 16 tooth gear on the rear wheel's axle drives a 16 tooth idler, which drives the 16 tooth gear on the motor's shaft.
functions.source: book: steps 6-10 (the motor and its gears), steps 15-16 (rear wheel), page 116 bottom-left inset (pull back, let go)

functions.does: The pull-back motor's spring drives the bike forward when it's pulled back and let go, fast enough to jump off the trailer ramp and through the fire ring over the truck.
functions.source: book: page 116 bottom-left and bottom-right insets
functions.skip: a spring motor only matters under force

functions.does: The bike's front wheel rolls freely on its axle in the fork.
The bike stands on a removable stand on the trailer; it lifts off for its run.
functions.source: book: page 116 middle inset (the stand drawn apart from the bike)
functions.note: not a control: the bike just lifts off

functions.does: The truck's doors swing open on their pins.
functions.source: inferred: the door1 and door2 submodels (steps 106-121) are pinned to the cab on one line; the book draws no arrow for them
